def mask_email(email):
    local, domain = email.split('@', 1)
    n = len(local)
    if n <= 1:
        return f'{local}@{domain}'
    keep_last = 1 if n > 2 else 0
    masked = local[0] + '*' * (n - 1 - keep_last) + local[n - keep_last:]
    return f'{masked}@{domain}'
